prompt: Can you run the upstream sync and see if anything new came in? If there's a PR, tell me what's in it and whether it's ready to merge.

assertions.text: Proposes `gh workflow run "Upstream Sync"` (or equivalent) with `--repo zjean/server`
assertions.rationale: Core to task 1; easy to get wrong if model defaults the repo to upstream

assertions.text: Describes monitoring the workflow run (`gh run watch` / `gh run list`) before moving on
Checks for a resulting PR with `gh pr list --base main --head upstream-main`
assertions.rationale: The workflow only opens a PR if upstream has new commits

assertions.text: Correctly identifies current state (sync already caught up, main contains everything upstream-main has)
assertions.rationale: The model should ground its answer in real repo state, not just describe the generic flow

assertions.text: Mentions 'Create a merge commit' strategy (not squash) for when an upstream-sync PR is actually merged
assertions.rationale: Repo-specific rule that differs from default feat/fix behaviour

assertions.text: Does NOT silently target Sync-in/server (upstream) for any command
assertions.rationale: Common model failure mode when `upstream` remote is configured
